class Pattern extends RegExp {}
const plain = /abc/g;
Object.setPrototypeOf(plain, {});
const boxed = new Number(5);
Object.setPrototypeOf(boxed, {});
const string = new String('ab');
Object.setPrototypeOf(string, {});
const pattern = new Pattern('abc', 'g');
const bare = /abc/g;
Object.setPrototypeOf(bare, null);
const emptyPrototype = /abc/g;
Object.setPrototypeOf(emptyPrototype, Object.create(null));
const boxedWithoutPrototype = new Number(5);
Object.setPrototypeOf(boxedWithoutPrototype, null);
const stringsWithoutPrototype = new String('z');
Object.setPrototypeOf(stringsWithoutPrototype, null);
const formatted = /abc/g;
Object.defineProperty(formatted, 'source', {value: 'changed'});
Object.defineProperty(formatted, 'flags', {value: 'y'});
console.log(plain, boxed, string, pattern, bare, emptyPrototype, boxedWithoutPrototype, stringsWithoutPrototype, formatted);
console.log('%o', plain);
console.log('%o', string);
console.log('%o', bare);
Object.defineProperty(pattern, 'extra', {value: 1, enumerable: true});
console.dir({nested: {pattern}}, {depth: 0});
